verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a first-party MCP Server explicitly for AI agents, supporting querying Core API data, virtual card issuance, and spend controls (velocity limits, spending caps, merchant restrictions), backed by matching Core API docs for cards, transactions, and authorization/velocity controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scoped/limited-permission credentials for the MCP surface itself and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
